monte_carlo_order_asset.reusable_precheck: Whenever a fixed RNG stream is consumed sequentially across experimental units, freeze statistical traversal order separately from execution order and regression-test the implementation against a content-addressed known result. A scientifically equivalent permutation distribution does not guarantee byte-reproducible Monte Carlo p-values after unit reordering.
monte_carlo_order_asset.does_not_imply: a scientific effect difference, method failure, core-principle failure, or invalidity of diversity-first execution ordering

reuse_scope.experiment_family: fixed-seed Monte Carlo or permutation inference
reuse_scope.failure_mode: execution reordering silently changes deterministic RNG consumption and therefore the reported finite Monte Carlo estimate
reuse_scope.required_separation: execution order versus analysis RNG traversal order

zero_provider_import_asset.reusable_precheck: A preflight declared zero-provider must not import modules whose top-level initialization constructs credential-bound or network-capable clients. Separate static routability/schema checks from runtime provider construction, record observable provider POSTs explicitly, and fail closed before scientific units if the preflight cannot remain credential-independent.
zero_provider_import_asset.does_not_imply: evaluator support failure, task-substrate failure, provider failure, model failure, or a scientific null

reuse_scope.experiment_family: zero-provider environment, evaluator, or substrate qualification
reuse_scope.failure_mode: import-time construction of a credential-bound client blocks a preflight before any scientific unit or provider POST
reuse_scope.repair_boundary: static evaluator/schema routability may replace import-time construction only when no outcome or model execution is required
